# LI liestates.7: estates pass to the heir (the primary heir, else the eldest child at court with no land)
LR_estates_death_on_action = {
	trigger = { LR_has_estates_trigger = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { primary_heir ?= { is_alive = yes is_landed = no } }
			LR_estates_pass_effect = { HEIR = primary_heir }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_child = { is_alive = yes is_landed = no is_adult = yes } }
			ordered_child = {
				limit = { is_alive = yes is_landed = no is_adult = yes }
				order_by = age
				save_scope_as = LR_estates_heir
			}
			LR_estates_pass_effect = { HEIR = scope:LR_estates_heir }
		}
	}
}

on_death = {
	on_actions = { LR_estates_death_on_action }
}
